item.title: Vilnius 2026: defending champion Chris Marlons confirmed
item.description: Reigning world champion Chris Marlons of Germany has confirmed his entry for the 2026 World Championships in Vilnius.

item.title: Vilnius named host of the 2026 World Championships
item.description: The 2026 Coin Spinning World Championships will take place in Vilnius, Lithuania, on 14–15 November 2026.

item.title: Updated timing standard for the 2026 season
item.description: From the 2026 season, plate temperature will be recorded before every round at sanctioned events.

item.title: Marlons wins second world title in Bratislava
item.description: Chris Marlons of Germany won the 2025 Coin Spinning World Championships in Bratislava with 20.88 seconds.
